posts.title: What’s With All the Goats?
posts.description: In 2021, Bay Area Rapid Transit ( BART ) described hiring hundreds of goats to graze its right-of-way lands . The sight of animal herds in an urban setting is great for placemaking, but how effective are they at preventing wildfires? posts.title: Safer Streets vs Speedier Response: A False Dichotomy?
posts.description: In 2024, a fascinating interdepartmental debate played out across the pages of a City of Toronto staff report. Transportation Services wanted to install over 60 new speed humps as part of the City’s Traffic Calming Policy. posts.title: CERT: The Paradox of Organized Self-Reliance
posts.description: In 1985, LA fire officials visited Japan and Mexico and took away a simple lesson: when disaster strikes, neighbors are the first available to help. This inspired LAFD to create the Community Emergency Response Team ( CERT ) program.
